criteria.evidence: Story docs and docs/design-system/using-components.md identify immutable application-supplied facts/destinations and library-owned presentation; built index discovers exactly 15 story exports and excludes helpers.

negative_invariants: A Repository Dossier story must never invent Team Kitty discovery, routing, polling, timestamps, truth inference, progress arithmetic, or command execution.
A terminal or pending repository state must never expose completed snapshot facts or actions.
A tracker label without a supplied safe HTTP(S) destination must remain static text.
A merged Mission must not remain in the unmerged navigation shortcut list.
A visual baseline is not accepted until its individual approved-state comparison and cross-screen family review are recorded.
